regions.today: Today will be warm and dry with sunny spells, although sea fog is possible on southern coasts for a time. Highest temperatures of 19 to 24 degrees with a light to moderate south to southwest breeze.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry and clear. Patches of mist and fog will develop in a light and variable wind. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 12 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Mist and fog patches will clear tomorrow morning and it will be a dry day with long spells of sunshine. Warm or very warm with highest temperatures of 23 to 27 degrees, in a light southerly or variable breeze.
